title: Rescue Squad: Behemoth's Bad Day (lore build)
summary: The Rescue Squad animals were each made to help a new summoning mechanic, not to work together. So this list follows their cast in card art instead. All four appear in Emerging Emergency Rescute Rescue, rescuing the hedgehog that later became Rescue Hedgehog. Rescue Cat marches with the animals in The Big March of Animals. And Rescue Rabbit has a running story with Behemoth the King of All Animals: it knocks him out in Lucky Punch, and he's still afraid of Rabbit in Underdog and Duck Dummy.

summary.title: Who's in it, and why
points: The Rescue Squad: Cat, Rabbit, Hedgehog, Ferret and Hamster, with Emerging Emergency Rescute Rescue.
Animals from The Big March of Animals as their targets: Sleeping Lion for Rabbit, 3-Hump Lacooda and Mystical Sheep #2 for Cat and Hedgehog.
Behemoth's side of the story: Behemoth the King of All Animals, and Alpha, the Master of Beasts and Super-Nimble Mega Hamster from Underdog's artwork.
The art cards that work here: The Big March of Animals, The Big Cattle Drive and Three of a Kind.

summary.title: Opening: Rescute Rescue & The Rescuers
steps: Activate Emerging Emergency Rescute Rescue when your LP are lower than your opponent's to reveal Rescue Rabbit, Rescue Cat, and Rescue Hedgehog, letting your opponent pick one for your hand.
Normal Summon Rescue Rabbit and banish it to Special Summon two copies of Sleeping Lion from your Deck.
Alternatively, Normal Summon Rescue Cat and send it to the GY to Special Summon two copies of 3-Hump Lacooda from your Deck.
Use the summoned Beasts immediately as material for Rank 4 Xyz or Synchro plays before they are destroyed during the End Phase.

summary.title: Bosses & Payoff
points: Behemoth the King of All Animals can be Normal Summoned with only one tribute as a 2000 ATK beater and returns Beasts from the GY to your hand equal to the number of tributed monsters.
Alpha, the Master of Beasts Special Summons itself when the opponent's total ATK exceeds yours, then bounces any number of your Beasts to return that many opponent face-up monsters to the hand.
Evolzar Laggia provides Summon or Spell/Trap negation, while Evolzar Dolkka provides monster effect negation when overlaid using Sleeping Lion.
Brionac, Dragon of the Ice Barrier discards cards to bounce multiple opponent cards, while Goyo Guardian steals monsters destroyed by battle.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Three of a Kind destroys three cards your opponent controls whenever you field three monsters with the same name, which 3-Hump Lacooda and Sleeping Lion easily fulfill.
The Big March of Animals boosts all Beast monsters you control by 200 ATK for each Beast monster on your field, turning a swarm of rescued animals into an aggressive push.
The Big Cattle Drive draws additional cards based on the different Types among Beast, Beast-Warrior, and Winged Beast monsters you control.
3-Hump Lacooda lets an unnegated copy tribute two other copies you control to draw three cards.

main: Rescue Rabbit
Banishes itself for two same-name Level 4 Normals, such as Sleeping Lion.
Rescue Cat
Sends itself to the GY for two Level 3 or lower Beasts.
Rescue Hedgehog
Banishes itself for a matching Normal and Effect Monster.
Rescue Ferret
Shuffles itself back for monsters totalling Level 6 next to a Link.
Rescue Hamster
Tributes itself for two copies of a Pendulum in your Extra Deck.
Sleeping Lion
Level 4 Normal Beast from the Big March; Rabbit's pair.
3-Hump Lacooda
Level 3 Beast from the Big March; three of them draw three.
Mystical Sheep #2
Level 3 Normal Beast from the Big March; Hedgehog's Normal half.
Behemoth the King of All Animals
Rabbit's sparring partner: one-tribute summon that returns Beasts.
Alpha, the Master of Beasts
Summons itself when they have more ATK; bounces your Beasts to bounce as many of theirs.
Super-Nimble Mega Hamster
Flips to set a Level 3 or lower Beast from the Deck.
Emerging Emergency Rescute Rescue
They pick one of three rescuers for your hand.
The Big March of Animals
Beasts gain ATK per Beast you control.
The Big Cattle Drive
Draws per Beast, Beast-Warrior or Winged Beast Type you control.
Three of a Kind
With three same-name monsters, destroys three cards.
